name: How long does it take to complete a Comparative Market Analysis?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete a Comparative Market Analysis?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time it takes to complete a Comparative Market Analysis (CMA) can vary depending on the complexity of the property and the availability of comparable data. Typically, it can be prepared within a few days once all necessary property information is gathered. Providing accurate details about your home, such as upgrades, square footage, and unique features, can help expedite the process for a precise analysis.
acceptedAnswer.description: A CMA typically takes a few days, depending on property complexity and data availability. Providing accurate property details can speed it up.
